There is nowhere to record an approval, and anything the copy check does not refuse is lined up to go out. The check writes down that a person should look at it; nothing waits for one. Saying "held until approved" here would be false.
◆
Credit repair ignores this switch completely. Every credit-repair post that is not refused outright is marked as needing a person to approve it, before this setting is even looked at, and that cannot be turned off. This partner has 0 credit-repair posts.
Separately: a credit-repair post that does not itself carry the words "Consumer Credit File Rights Under State and Federal Law" is refused, not merely held.
